The '''Tularan Marsh offensive''' was one of the last battles fought in the aftermath of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]'s [[Invasion of Taris]] and was considered the final push which drove the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It concluded in the destruction of a secret Republic [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on the edges of the [[Tularan Marsh]], which threatened the Empire's [[Navy/Legends|naval]] dominance above [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], through an [[orbital bombardment]].
